tracking: ADR-0327 addendum (lane E12, owner approval 2026-11-17, competitor gap audit Camunda row 6): API and backend only; the decision-table editor (rows, review, history) is for UI-D (#453)

gaps.GET /v1/decision-tables: lists decision tables (business-authored conditions and outcomes per AI step) with their published and in-review versions, under the ADR-0226 list contract
gaps.POST /v1/decision-tables: creates a decision table bound to one AI step (agent and step name), audited
gaps.GET /v1/decision-tables/:id: reads a decision table: the published and in-review versions with their readable rows and test cases, and recent history
gaps.POST /v1/decision-tables/:id/versions: proposes a new decision-table version (schema-validated, compiled to the exact-match rule engine) for review by a named administrator in the approvals queue, audited; published only on approval
